sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 30 seconds for one time only.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
